SELECT rd.botdetreg AS robot_id, rd.mfgnameval AS manufacturer, rd.modelseriesval AS model,
  ROUND((3600.0 / o.cycletimesecval)::numeric, 2) AS throughput_cycles_per_hour
FROM robot_details rd
JOIN operation o ON o.operrecref = rd.botdetreg
WHERE o.cycletimesecval > 0 AND 3600.0 / o.cycletimesecval < 180
ORDER BY throughput_cycles_per_hour ASC
LIMIT 5

WITH t AS (
  SELECT j.jcdetref AS robot_id, j.jcondoperref,
    ARRAY[(j.joint_health->'J1'->>'temperature_C')::numeric,(j.joint_health->'J2'->>'temperature_C')::numeric,(j.joint_health->'J3'->>'temperature_C')::numeric,(j.joint_health->'J4'->>'temperature_C')::numeric,(j.joint_health->'J5'->>'temperature_C')::numeric,(j.joint_health->'J6'->>'temperature_C')::numeric] AS temps
  FROM joint_condition j
), th AS (
  SELECT robot_id, jcondoperref,
    (SELECT AVG(x) FROM unnest(temps) x) AS avg_t,
    (SELECT MAX(x) FROM unnest(temps) x) AS max_t,
    (SELECT MAX(x)-MIN(x) FROM unnest(temps) x) AS diff_t
  FROM t
)
SELECT th.robot_id, rd.modelseriesval AS model,
  (1000.0/(m.rulhours+1)) + (m.faultpredscore*10) AS maintenance_urgency_score,
  th.max_t AS max_joint_temperature
FROM th
JOIN maintenance_and_fault m ON m.upkeepoperation = th.jcondoperref
JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = th.robot_id
WHERE (1000.0/(m.rulhours+1)) + (m.faultpredscore*10) > 50
  AND (th.avg_t > 75 OR th.diff_t > 15)
ORDER BY maintenance_urgency_score DESC, max_joint_temperature DESC

WITH s AS (
  SELECT sc.systemoverseeroperation AS operreg, o.operrecref AS robot_id, rd.mfgnameval, rd.modelseriesval,
    (sc.overseerloadvalue + sc.memuseval)/2.0 AS stress_score
  FROM system_controller sc
  JOIN operation o ON o.operreg = sc.systemoverseeroperation
  JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = o.operrecref
), a AS (
  SELECT s.*, AVG(stress_score) OVER (PARTITION BY modelseriesval) AS model_avg_stress FROM s
), w AS (
  SELECT j.jcondoperref,
    0.6 * (SELECT AVG((v->>'vibration_mmps')::numeric) FROM jsonb_each(j.joint_health) e(k,v))
  + 0.4 * (SELECT AVG((v->>'backlash_deg')::numeric) FROM jsonb_each(j.joint_health) e(k,v)) AS mechanical_wear_score
  FROM joint_condition j
)
SELECT a.robot_id, a.mfgnameval AS manufacturer, LOWER(a.modelseriesval) AS model, a.stress_score, w.mechanical_wear_score
FROM a JOIN w ON w.jcondoperref = a.operreg
WHERE a.stress_score >= 1.2*a.model_avg_stress
  AND w.mechanical_wear_score >= 0.5
ORDER BY manufacturer, a.stress_score DESC

WITH s AS (
  SELECT o.operrecref AS robot_id, rd.modelseriesval,
    (sc.overseerloadvalue + sc.memuseval)/2.0 AS stress_score
  FROM system_controller sc
  JOIN operation o ON o.operreg = sc.systemoverseeroperation
  JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = o.operrecref
), a AS (
  SELECT s.*, AVG(stress_score) OVER (PARTITION BY modelseriesval) AS model_avg_stress FROM s
)
SELECT robot_id, LOWER(modelseriesval) AS model, stress_score, model_avg_stress
FROM a WHERE stress_score > 1.2*model_avg_stress
ORDER BY stress_score DESC

SELECT a.actrecref AS robot_id, o.apptypeval AS application_type,
  a.poserrmmval / rd.reachmmval AS relative_positional_error,
  ps.calibstateval AS calibration_state
FROM actuation_data a
JOIN operation o ON o.operreg = a.actoperref
JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = a.actrecref
JOIN performance_and_safety ps ON ps.effectivenessactuation = a.actreg
WHERE o.apptypeval IN ('Assembly','Electronics-Handling','Inspection','Dispensing','Laser Cutting')
  AND a.poserrmmval / NULLIF(rd.reachmmval,0) > 0.0001
ORDER BY relative_positional_error DESC

WITH b AS (
  SELECT a.actrecref AS robot_id, rd.modelseriesval AS model,
    a.payloadwval / NULLIF(rd.payloadcapkg,0) AS payload_utilization_ratio,
    60.0 / NULLIF(o.cycletimesecval,0) AS throughput_rate,
    NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY o.apptypeval ORDER BY 60.0 / NULLIF(o.cycletimesecval,0) DESC NULLS LAST) AS tp_quintile
  FROM actuation_data a
  JOIN operation o ON o.operreg = a.actoperref
  JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = a.actrecref
)
SELECT robot_id, model, payload_utilization_ratio, throughput_rate
FROM b
WHERE payload_utilization_ratio > 0.8 AND tp_quintile = 1
ORDER BY payload_utilization_ratio DESC, throughput_rate DESC

SELECT a.actrecref AS robot_id, m.faultpredscore AS fault_prediction_score,
  m.rulhours / 24.0 AS remaining_useful_life_days
FROM maintenance_and_fault m
JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actreg = m.upkeepactuation
WHERE m.rulhours / 24.0 < 7 AND m.faultpredscore > 0.7
ORDER BY remaining_useful_life_days ASC, fault_prediction_score DESC

WITH h AS (
  SELECT ps.effectivenessrobot AS robot_id, rd.mfgnameval,
    (1.0 - ps.conditionindexval) / NULLIF(CURRENT_DATE - rd.instdateval, 0) AS hdr
  FROM performance_and_safety ps
  JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = ps.effectivenessrobot
)
SELECT LOWER(mfgnameval) AS manufacturer, COUNT(*) AS degrading_robot_count, AVG(hdr) AS avg_health_degradation_rate
FROM h WHERE hdr > 0
GROUP BY LOWER(mfgnameval)
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

WITH r AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN o.apptypeval IN ('Welding','Grinding','Deburring','Palletizing','Machine Tending')
              THEN 'High-Wear Applications' ELSE 'Other Applications' END AS application_group,
    CASE WHEN o.totopshrval / NULLIF(ps.emergencystopcount,0) < 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS high_risk
  FROM performance_and_safety ps
  JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actreg = ps.effectivenessactuation
  JOIN operation o ON o.operreg = a.actoperref
)
SELECT application_group, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(high_risk) / COUNT(*), 2) AS high_risk_percentage
FROM r GROUP BY application_group

SELECT ROUND(AVG((e.v->>'vibration_mmps')::numeric), 2) AS avg_joint_vibration
FROM joint_condition j CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(j.joint_health) AS e(k, v)
